name: Chip
description: SEED contract for the ALTITUDE round — props/axes only; anatomy is promoted from captured DOM truth. Subject: altitude-web-components@1.0.2 (published npm, Lit 3, SHADOW DOM), pinned in examples/altitude/.altitude-sandbox (examples/altitude/PROVENANCE.md). EVERY enum in this library is DEFAULTLESS — the default rendering is the ABSENCE of the attribute (there is no `variant="primary"`; primary IS unset), so every axis leads with the `unset` pseudo-value. No `disabled` state plane: Altitude never reaches the `:disabled` pseudo-class from a prop on these components (al-button's isDisabled emits aria-disabled ONLY — measured identical background, cursor and opacity — and the other seven spell it as an `al-is-disabled` class, which is a prop-selected RENDERING, i.e. a variant axis, not a pseudo-class plane). al-chip. `isDismissible` DEFERRED BY NAME: it mounts a nested <al-icon-close> (a second shadow root inside this one) and `close()` mutates the HOST's classList — a depth-2 presence subtree with a self-mutating driver, out of round 1.
